name: Kanemori Aoi
source:
St. Ao Academy 3rd year high school student. A class.

[url=/c47192]Kyou's[/url] younger brother.
A popular model, he has a cheeky attitude.
He recently transferred in to this school, but because of work he doesn't attend class often.
He doesn't like that his older brother worries about him so much, and he is rather more worried about him.
